cohort: 422,134 low-risk singleton pregnancies with a term live birth in Ontario, Canada between April 2012 and March 2018, excluding those with prior CD
finding: Planned CDMR was not associated with an increased risk for neonatal or infant infections compared with planned VD.
mod_finding: Planned CDMR was not associated with increased risk for neonatal or infant infections compared with planned VD, however actual CD (planned and unplanned) was associated with an increased risk for infant infections compared to actual VD.
